html:
Binh Hung Island and Vinh Hy Bay are two hidden gems of Vietnam’s South Central Coast, located in Khanh Hoa and Ninh Thuan provinces. Each destination offers a distinctive charm, pristine landscapes, and unforgettable travel experiences for nature lovers and sea explorers.

Both places are ideal for travelers seeking untouched beauty, crystal-clear waters, and authentic local culture. However, to choose the destination that truly suits your travel style, budget, and time, it is essential to understand their differences in depth.

This guide by Vietlook Travel provides a detailed comparison of Binh Hung Island and Vinh Hy Bay, helping you make the best decision for your upcoming Vietnam coastal journey.

Binh Hung Island – Untouched Beauty And Authentic Island Life

Where Is Binh Hung Island And What Makes It Special?

Binh Hung Island, also known as Hon Ty or Hon Chut, is a small island located in Cam Binh Commune, Cam Ranh City, Khanh Hoa Province. Nestled at the foot of the coastal road connecting Binh Tien – Vinh Hy, the island belongs to Cam Ranh Bay, one of the deepest natural bays in the world.

Binh Hung is famous for its silky white sand beaches, emerald-clear seawater, and colorful coral reefs visible even from the shore. As part of the “Tam Binh” island group, Binh Hung retains its peaceful fishing-village atmosphere, largely untouched by mass tourism. Thanks to its breathtaking scenery, it is often referred to as the “Maldives of Vietnam.”

This island is perfect for travelers who appreciate simplicity, tranquility, and close contact with nature.

How To Get To Binh Hung Island And Estimated Costs

Travelers can reach Binh Hung Island using various transportation options:

  • By Road: From Ho Chi Minh City, sleeper buses to Cam Ranh or Nha Trang take approximately 9–10 hours, with ticket prices ranging from 250,000–400,000 VND per way. From My Thanh junction, visitors continue by motorbike or taxi to the pier, then take a short boat ride to the island.

  • By Train: Trains from Ho Chi Minh City to Nha Trang take about 8 hours, with ticket prices between 300,000–450,000 VND. Overnight trains are recommended for convenience. From Nha Trang Station, travelers proceed to the Binh Hung pier.

  • By Air: Flights to Cam Ranh International Airport are the fastest option, especially from Hanoi or northern provinces. Round-trip airfare usually ranges from 1,000,000–3,000,000 VND, depending on the route. From Cam Ranh Airport, it takes a short drive to the pier, followed by a boat ride costing 10,000–20,000 VND per person.

Best Time To Visit Binh Hung Island

The best time to visit Binh Hung Island is from March to August, when the weather is sunny, the sea is calm, and water visibility is excellent for swimming and snorkeling. Average temperatures range from 28–32°C, ideal for outdoor activities.

Travelers should avoid the rainy season from September to December, when rough seas may affect transportation and safety.

Accommodation Options On Binh Hung Island

  • Hotels and Guesthouses: Prices range from 300,000–700,000 VND per night, offering basic comfort and sea views.

  • Homestays: Ideal for cultural immersion, with prices from 200,000–500,000 VND per night.

  • Beach Camping: A favorite option for adventure lovers, offering a unique experience under the stars at minimal cost.

Must-Visit Attractions On Binh Hung Island

  • Bai Kinh Beach: The island’s main gateway and a perfect spot to watch sunrise.

  • Bai Chuoi Beach: Deeper waters and gentle waves, ideal for swimming lovers.

  • Freshwater Beach (Bai Nuoc Ngot): A rare natural blend of freshwater stream and seawater.

  • Hon Chut Lighthouse: Panoramic views of Cam Ranh Bay, perfect for sunset photography.

  • Bai Me Beach: A snorkeling paradise accessible only by boat.

  • Tau Cave & Lovers’ Cave: Unique natural formations with crystal-clear water.

  • Bird Nest Swing: A popular photo spot floating above the sea.

  • Long Hung Pagoda & Nam Hai Whale Temple: Cultural and spiritual landmarks.

Binh Hung Island Cuisine – Fresh Seafood At Its Best

  • Fish cake noodle soup

  • Squid mini pancakes

  • Seaweed drink

  • Spiny lobster (local specialty)

  • Sea urchin dishes

  • Green chili grilled squid

All seafood is freshly caught and reasonably priced compared to mainland cities.

Vinh Hy Bay – Majestic Nature And Cultural Discovery

Location And Natural Setting

Vinh Hy Bay is located in Vinh Hai Commune, Ninh Hai District, Ninh Thuan Province, about 40 km from Phan Rang City. It is considered one of the four most beautiful bays in Vietnam and lies adjacent to Nui Chua National Park, creating a rare ecosystem of mountains, forest, and sea.

Vinh Hy enjoys a dry, mild climate year-round and is less affected by storms, making it ideal for extended exploration.

How To Get To Vinh Hy Bay

  • By Train: From Ho Chi Minh City to Thap Cham Station, ticket prices range from 250,000–500,000 VND.

  • By Air: Flights to Cam Ranh Airport, then travel by road to Vinh Hy.

  • By Coach: Sleeper buses from Ho Chi Minh City to Phan Rang cost 150,000–250,000 VND.

Accommodation In Vinh Hy

  • Camping: Ideal for groups and nature lovers.

  • Guesthouses & Small Hotels: Prices range from 250,000–600,000 VND per night.

  • Luxury Resorts: Amanoi Resort offers world-class luxury and privacy for high-end travelers.

Best Time To Visit Vinh Hy Bay

The ideal period is from February to October, especially May to August, when the sea is calm and visibility is excellent for snorkeling and marine activities.

Top Experiences In Vinh Hy

  • Snorkeling and scuba diving

  • Glass-bottom boat tours

  • Banana boat rides

  • Hang Rai natural rock formations

  • Nui Chua National Park trekking

  • Cham cultural sites

  • Sheep fields and sand dunes

  • Grape farms and local wineries

Vinh Hy Seafood Specialties

  • Scallops

  • Blue swimmer crabs

  • Lady snail

  • Grouper fish

  • Raw Mai fish salad

Binh Hung Or Vinh Hy – Which One Should You Choose?

Travel Duration

  • Binh Hung: Best for 2 days 1 night or 3 days 2 nights

  • Vinh Hy: Ideal for 3 days 2 nights or longer

Atmosphere

  • Binh Hung: Peaceful, rustic, fishing village lifestyle

  • Vinh Hy: Grand landscapes, adventure combined with relaxation

Activities

  • Binh Hung: Swimming, snorkeling, seafood, cultural immersion

  • Vinh Hy: Water sports, trekking, Cham culture, photography

Budget

  • Binh Hung: More budget-friendly

  • Vinh Hy: Flexible, from budget to luxury

Your Perfect Coastal Escape With Vietlook Travel

Both Binh Hung Island and Vinh Hy Bay offer unforgettable seaside experiences, each catering to different travel styles. If you seek tranquility, authenticity, and simplicity, Binh Hung is the perfect choice. If you prefer dramatic landscapes, diverse activities, and deeper exploration, Vinh Hy will captivate you.

No matter which destination you choose, Vietlook Travel is here to help you craft the perfect journey with well-designed itineraries, reliable services, and local expertise.
